name: m_ex_fix_mask_passthrough
description: [mapgen fix types_nodes#3] Data Masking with passthrough: the e-mail is masked, and an Expression downstream uses the ORIGINAL names (name, email) next to the out_ ports - the shape that failed with TE_7002 before. Target ex_fix_mask_out (out_email, email, name, out_name, id INT64, out_id INT64, label).

nodes.name: SRC_PEOPLE
nodes.query: SELECT 'Jane.Doe@example.com' AS email, 'Jane Doe' AS name, 101 AS id UNION ALL SELECT 'bob.roe@example.org', 'Bob Roe', 102
